makemoney.autodrop.triggerWay.desc:
Three ways of trigger AutoDrop:


1. Time trigger

2. Pick up item trigger

3. Open container trigger


They don't conflict with each other, you can enable all of them at the same time.

makemoney.autodrop.pickUpItemTrigger.des:
Trigger the drop function when picking up a designated drops.

After triggering, if the timed triggering function is also enabled, the timed triggering will be re timed. 

It is recommended to use it together with timed triggering to prevent the inability to pick up items when the inventory is full, which may result in continuous failure to trigger. 

There is a slight issue, as it is detected by monitoring data packets. Therefore, when discarding, the backpack may not have updated the picked up items yet, causing the newly picked up items to remain in the backpack. However, the problem is not significant and will not be changed.
makemoney.autodrop.triggerItemId: Specify the drops ID triggered by picking

Support format such as/regular expressions/.

Add preset matching items.

The built-in presets include:

Triple Conflict Enchanted Weapon

Four Conflict Enchanted Armor

makemoney.autodrop.matchItem.enabled.des: Whether to enable this match item.
makemoney.autodrop.matchItem.itemName.de:
Specify the name of the item to match.

Such as "Blaze Rod".

 * matches all item names.

You can use the format /regular expression/ to match.

Example: /netherite.*/ to match all netherite items.
makemoney.autodrop.matchItem.itemID.desc:
Specify the item ID to match. Such as "blaze_rod".

 * matches all item IDs.

You can use the format /minecraft:(?:diamond|netherite).*/ to match all diamond and netherite items.

For detailed item IDs, please refer to https://minecraft.wiki/w/Java_Edition_data_values#Items
By matching the minimum durability required, if the item does not have durability attributes, it can be directly matched.

Special values:

-1 matches items with full durability.

-2 matches items with non-full durability.
makemoney.autodrop.matchItem.itemTags.de:
Specify the item tags to match. Such as "#head_armor".

 * matches all item tags.

You can use the format #tag to match.

Example: #a, #b, #c.

For detailed item tags, please refer to https://minecraft.wiki/w/Item_tag_(Java_Edition)
makemoney.autodrop.matchItem.minEnchantR:
The minimum number of enchantments required to match the item.

Only if the item contains at least this number of enchantments.

n-1 matches all with enchantments.
makemoney.autodrop.matchItem.enchantment:
Matching enchantments and levels.

Enchantment with levels must be accompanied by levels, while enchantment without levels can be ignored or written as 1.

The enchanting level must be greater than or equal to this level in order to be matched.

For example: mending

Sharpness V：sharpness:5

Lotting III：looting:3

For detailed item IDs, please refer to: https://minecraft.wiki/w/Enchantment#Enchantments

makemoney.fixSignInIssue: 修复签到后无法同步背包数据bug
makemoney.fixSignInIssue.desc:
在拾玖世界签到后，服务器可能未能正确关闭上一个容器界面，

这导致了服务端认为玩家仍处于某个容器界面，

发送的背包数据也是容器界面的数据。

但客户端已经关闭了容器界面，所以会将收到的背包数据当作垃圾丢掉，

但这也导致了客户端的背包数据无法同步服务器。


此功能用于解决此 bug

makemoney.messageCommand.rule.enabled.de: When disabled, the rule will not be used.
makemoney.messageCommand.rule.matcher.de:
Match regular expressions for specific messages.

Support the use of capture groups and use them in corresponding commands.

For example, someone sends a message to the server: `<Him> Hello bro !`

Set matching rule: `<(\w+)> (\w+)`

Command can be set to: `/say ${1} send a message: ${2}`

After replacement, it will execute: `/say Him send a message: Hello bro !`
makemoney.messageCommand.rule.command: The command to be executed after successful matching
makemoney.messageCommand.rule.command.de:
You can replace the placeholders set by this command with the content captured by the matching rules.

The placeholder format is §7${capture group number}§r or §7${capture group number:default value}，§r

Capture group numbers starting from 1, with number 0 representing the complete matching content.

If a capture group is optional and no content is matched, will replace with default values.

The default value can be omitted, and its initial value is an empty string.

The following format is legal:

§7/tell ${1} ${2:aa}

/tell ${1:TAOtxi} ${2:aaa}

/pay ${2:TAOtxi} ${1}§r

If there is no slash in the prefix, it is considered as sending a chat message.

§cNote that the capture group number should not exceed the number of capture groups!

makemoney.mendingHelper.autoReplace.name: Auto replace mending equipment
makemoney.mendingHelper.autoReplace.desc: After activation, when the experience orb is obtained, equipment with mending enchantment and less durability will be automatically replaced by the offhand.
makemoney.mendingHelper.autoEnchant.name: Auto combine mending book
makemoney.mendingHelper.autoEnchant.desc:
When opening the anvil, it automatically repairs the enchanted experience for the equipment.

Note that after enabling this feature, if there are no enchanted raw materials in the player's inventory, the anvil gui will automatically close, which means that during this period, the player cannot manually operate the anvil.
makemoney.mendingHelper.autoDecompose.de:
Standing on the gold nugget automatically triggers decomposition. 

Automatically place equipment that meets the decomposition criteria into the main hand and attempt to right-click on the gold nugget.
makemoney.mendingHelper.onlyDecomposeNon: After closing, it will try to decompose at least one raw material equipment.
makemoney.mendingHelper.autoRepair.name: Auto repair equipment
makemoney.mendingHelper.autoRepair.desc:
When there is netherite equipment in the inventory that is not yet durable and lacks mending enchantments, an attempt will be made to retrieve the mending book from the specified container and automatically open the nearby anvil to enchant it. 

Attention: This feature requires first enabling "AutoReplace" and "AutoEnchant", otherwise it will not work properly. 

Before opening the anvil container, it is impossible to calculate the experience level required for enchanting. 

Therefore, in order to prevent inexperienced players from repeatedly opening the anvil, automatic patching can only be triggered when the player's level is greater than or equal to level 5. Please ensure that the player has sufficient experience. 

Consumption Guide: This feature is designed to automatically increase the durability of netherite equipment caught during fishing.

Therefore, in the AutoDrop module, it is necessary to keep all netherite equipment with less durability. However, I have not found a more convenient way to match alloy equipment, so I can only use the method of enumerating IDs. The regular expression for matching IDs can refer to:

^minecraft:netherite_(?:helmet|chestplate|leggings|boots|sword|axe|pickaxe|shovel|hoe)$
makemoney.mendingHelper.mendingBookPosit: The position store the mending book container

Coordinate format: §7<x, y, z>§r.

Used for automatic repair of alloy equipment, the container must be within 4.5 blocks.
§7[§dMendingHelper§7] §aSet the mending book container position to §7<%d, %d, %d>§r

makemoney.autoAFK.autoAttack.desc: Adjust attack interval based on server tps
makemoney.autoAFK.autoAttack.enabled.des:
After activation, it will automatically attack entity.

This function is used to trigger the sweeping effect even when the server is stuck.

Briefly explain the problem of difficulty triggering sweeping when the server TPS is low:

If TPS is too low, the server's time will be slower compared to ours,

Correspondingly, we have become faster in the eyes of the server.

An attack with a cycle of 10 ticks on the client may appear to the server to be 7 or even lower.

Therefore, it is necessary to adjust the attack cycle according to TPS.

Automatic adjustment cycle formula:

Actual attack cycle=set attack cycle/(tps/20)
makemoney.autoAFK.autoAttack.interval.de: Set the relative cycle of adaptive attack, unit: tick
makemoney.autoAFK.autoAttack.durabilityC: Stop attack when the tool durability is low.
makemoney.autoAFK.autoAttack.showInfo.de: After activation, it will display the current attack cycle information above the item bar.
makemoney.autoAFK.autoAttack.mode.desc:
Only attack entities in the attack list.

If disabled, attack all entities except those in the attack list.
makemoney.autoAFK.autoAttack.list.desc:
Set the list of entities to attack, value is the entity id, lowercase.

For example, player, zombie_villager...
makemoney.autoAFK.tpsCheck.desc: When the server TPS falls below the set threshold, the set command will be triggered.
makemoney.autoAFK.tpsCheck.enabled.desc:
After activation, it will check if the server TPS is below the set threshold.

If it is lower than, a remedial command will be triggered.

After triggering, in order to prevent repeated triggering, the detection function will be automatically turned off.

If the TPS is greater than or equal to the TPS good threshold thereafter, the reset command will be triggered.

For example, when tps is below 8, the /spawn command is triggered,

Afterwards, when tps exceeds 16, the /back command is triggered.
makemoney.autoAFK.tpsCheck.threshold.des:
Note that the server TPS is estimated, and is an average value.

Therefore, when tps is below the threshold, the command will not be triggered immediately.
makemoney.autoAFK.tpsCheck.greenThreshol:
When tps exceeds this value, the set command will be triggered.

This value must be greater than the tps danger threshold, otherwise the consequences will be your own responsibility.
makemoney.autoAFK.tpsCheck.command.desc:
The command that will be triggered when TPS is below the danger threshold.

This value needs to be set with caution, as TPS is an estimated value and not the actual server TPS,

In poor network conditions, the estimated TPS may have significant errors,

it may lead to triggering commands incorrectly.
After the reset command is triggered, the set command that will be triggered when TPS exceeds the good threshold.

If this value is empty, skip it.
